description: With the wide_verify candidate option, Flash TP4 verify steps of 65 to 192 rows run the routed experts through the wide direct MoE queues instead of the 8192-row expert chains. The locked bandwidth_moe_deepseek41_wide_sm120 module loads exactly where the dense wide fold module does, once per rank, and resolves its 12 entries. In each MoE layer of those steps the gate/up chain, its ceil quantizer and the down chain become the pack, absorbing gate queue, gate finisher and two-strip down queue, and the routed sum becomes the down finisher. Without the option every journal, create range and history is identical.
